Counsel for Applicant :- Dharmendra Kumar

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed by the learned counsel for the applicant is taken in the record.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.122 of 2022 at Police Station-Kotwali Hata, District-Kushinagar under Sections 498A, 304B,
328, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of the D.P. Act.
The applicant is in jail since 23.05.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 05.10.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Dharmendra Kumar, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Shiv Chauhan vs State Of U.P. on 8 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199294961/

sentences.text: 1. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
2. The applicant did not harass the deceased or demand dowry.
They had a harmonious relationship.
3. The applicant resides in Qatar for a living.
4. The deceased was a sensitive lady who became depressed on account of prolonged separation from her husband.
5. On the fateful day, she succumbed to depression and took some poisonous substance.
6. The applicant was not in India at the time of incident.
7. The applicant did not aid or abet the suicide.
8. The prerequisites for attracting the presumption and reversing the burden of proof are not established in the facts and circumstances and evidence of the case.
9. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
10. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Shiv Chauhan be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.
The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
( i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 8.11.2023 Ashish Tripathi  Shiv Chauhan vs State Of U.P. on 8 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199294961/
